svg.title: Keyword matching scenarios — Cheesy Chicken Pasta and Banana Bread Muffins
svg.desc: Two real keyword examples matched against article titles using 3-word full match, 2-word partial match, and evergreen fallback logic.
svg.text: Match each keyword phrase against every eligible article title

g.text: Scenario B — 2-word partial match (lower score, still valid)
Scenario C — 1-word only (rejected — below minimum threshold)
Scenario D — Evergreen fallback (no period_type = always needed)

svg.text: After month + season passes complete, any article that matched 0 or 1 keywords in both passes
is automatically treated as evergreen — no extra CSV row required.
Valid match — lower priority in ranking
